name: gds-navigator
description: Open .gds layouts directly in VS Code with provenance-aware source navigation. Ported from superGDS Studio (fangrh/overages).

commands.title: GDS: Associate Python Script with Current Layout
GDS: Open Current File in GDS Navigator
GDS: Select Features by Source Line

gdsNavigator.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python executable used to parse GDS files and run build scripts. An explicit path or manually picked environment takes precedence. Otherwise GDS Navigator automatically checks installed environments and prefers verified provenance-enabled gdsfactory with klayout. Use **GDS: Select Python Environment** to choose or return to automatic detection. Detection never installs packages.

gdsNavigator.parseTimeoutSec.description: Timeout in seconds for parsing a GDS file.

gdsNavigator.usageLogging.enabled.description: Record local bounded usage events for workflow review. No network upload, geometry, instruction text, or clipboard contents. Disable to pause.
